offering_description.value: Provides professional engineering, surveying, planning and consulting services to private developers, utilities and public agencies. Delivers projects through staff engineers, surveyors, scientists and field crews across offices in the US, supporting land development, infrastructure and energy projects.

primary_services.value: civil engineering; land surveying; geospatial and subsurface utility engineering; environmental consulting; electrical and power engineering; construction management

customer_segment.value: B2B: real estate developers, utilities, renewable energy developers, commercial and industrial clients; B2G: municipalities, state transportation departments, public agencies, water districts

end_markets.value: real estate development; power and utilities; renewable energy; transportation; water and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: service fees: time-and-materials and hourly engineering and consulting work; project or contract: fixed-fee and contract-based design and project delivery

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses professional staff to deliver engineering and surveying services to developers, utilities and public agencies

geography_served.value: US national: offices across many US states, with projects nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: civil engineering, surveying, environmental, power and geospatial services sharing the same clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: business development staff pursuing clients and public agency bids and proposals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: licensed professional engineers and surveyors under state boards, environmental and permitting rules
